Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Building Broadband from the Ground Up - Episode 667 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Jordan Pittman on Nov 28, 2025 In this episode of the podcast, Chris speaks with Mauricio Rodriguez about the realities of managing broadband infrastructure projects—particularly on tribal lands. Mauricio shares lessons learned from years of navigating permitting, environmental reviews, land negotiations, and the complexities of coordinating with community members, federal agencies, and contractors. They discuss the critical importance of setting standards, realistic timelines, and hiring experts with local experience, as well as the unexpected challenges that arise—from zoning hurdles to wildlife encounters. Mauricio offers advice for community leaders stepping into this work for the first time, emphasizing patience, planning, and the value of strong partnerships in building networks that last.
